V17.scope: six original-A paired runs only; warmups and B excluded; windows separate

V22.scope: six original-A paired runs only; warmups and B excluded; windows separate

decision_basis: Engineering judgment from measured batch costs, unresolved timing boundaries and correctness risk; not a new benchmark.

priorities.work: 封存來源驗證與初始化分項診斷規格，再驗收觀測工具
evidence: Window initial/final closure hashing is measured at 35.43% and 39.37% of the two fixed48 windows.
Setup and entry-other are large observed regions but do not isolate hash/context/IO latency.
Publisher wall duration and individual source-check calls lack separate timers.
deliverable: A separate preregistration on the same original48; no new SQL rewrite or removal of source checks.
Wall boundaries and exact call traces for closure verification, CheckpointStore.create, post-lock writer recheck, load_context/catalog, verifier, tail, ledger proof/output and independent publisher.
Separate unique descriptors from actual repeated call counts and logical bytes; retain scoped setup/primary/entry/window/post-exit definitions.
acceptance: Same original48 order, immutable scientific outputs and physical bytes.
Every child timer stays within its parent; tail commit counted once; observer overhead reported.
Hash failures, same-size source changes, change between initial check and writer lock, lock/recovery faults, and publisher mismatches still reject.
One supervised sequential scope with source before/after checks; no retry selection or automatic candidate adoption.
priorities.reason: Measure the large mixed regions before choosing a correctness-sensitive change.

priorities.work: 依分項結果評估準備資料複用與來源快照設計
deliverable: Evaluate reuse of immutable catalog/context keyed by all source fingerprints, fit/config identities and causal filtering rules.

If repeated source verification dominates, design a provably stable snapshot or locked input lifetime; preserve before/after and independent publication protection, with explicit handling of renamed/replaced/modified inputs.
acceptance: Demonstrate the same causal candidates, scores and complete payload for unknown/empty/future inputs and context version changes.
Fresh processes, lock transitions, source mutation and source replacement cannot inherit a stale verification result.
Preregister separate full-entry and primary comparisons; a source-time saving must not be reported as a ranking improvement.
priorities.reason: The current bytes and setup/residual times provide opportunity evidence, not a measured speedup or permission to skip hashes.

priorities.work: 保存與預算查核排在來源／準備之後，保留尾端異常追蹤
evidence: Across the original-A paired runs direct budget publication is a small measured nested component.
V21 single-case append swing is dominated by a direct budget publication; V20 guard swing did not recur in V21.
deliverable: Keep direct budget, nested commit, final commit, context publication and payload encoding/write costs distinct.
Only reopen this work if new phase measurements show repeated, material end-to-end cost.
acceptance: Absolute/cumulative deadlines, writer immutability, fault ordering, checksum/ledger recovery and atomic publication semantics remain validated.
Do not remove acceptance/candidate/global guards, lengthen persistence intervals or drop durability merely to reduce a small timer.

priorities.work: 維持兩個 SQL 候選結案，完整驗收另立計畫
deliverable: Retain original V4 ranking. No automatic 34-query comparison, extra pairs, lower thresholds or new candidate selection from these results.
When larger engineering bottlenecks are understood, separately scope full validation acceptance/recovery/resource windows.
acceptance: Fixed48 and seven-case tail diagnostics remain exposed validation engineering evidence.
Do not extrapolate the batch window shares to 166897 validation queries or create a T_plan without a new justified specification.
Primary fits, full validation, bootstrap and reserved-test actions require their own authorized scope.
